description: This file contains functions for verifying and executing firmware or software upgrades on a Linux-based embedded device, including partition handling, image extraction, and device writing.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and consistency of an image before upgrading by comparing partition tables.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to a specific partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade, including image writing and partition management.
